title: In-depth exploration into the multifaceted regulatory mechanisms of carotenoid metabolism in microalgae.
authors: Liang, Ming-Hua; Li, Chong-Ping; Zhang, Wei-Ping; Wang, Da-Zhi
one_liner_zh: 综述微藻类胡萝卜素代谢的多层次调控机制，提及AI整合多组学但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅间接相关。
abstract: Microalgae offer a sustainable and efficient way to produce natural carotenoids, with advantages such as easy cultivation, rapid growth, efficient photosynthesis, high yield, no competition for arable land, and utilization of CO(2) and wastewater. With the growing demand for natural carotenoids, it is vital to explore ways to boost their production in microalgae. This requires a comprehensive understanding of the regulatory mechanisms underlying microalgal carotenoid metabolism. This review covers recent advances in the regulatory architecture of carotenoid biosynthesis in eukaryotic microalgae, highlighting how chemical and environmental cues reprogram transcription, post-translational modifications, chromatin state, epigenetic marks, and metabolic flux to balance carotenoid accumulation with cell growth and stress tolerance. Dissecting these multifaceted regulatory mechanisms by integrating multi-omics, molecular biology, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools will enable the rational engineering of high-quality intelligent microalgal strains with elevated carotenoid output, robust photosynthetic performance, and improved stress tolerance. This review provides new insights into the optimization of microalgal carotenoid production for industrial applications and the regulatory mechanisms of microalgal carotenoid metabolism.
abstract_zh: 微藻提供了一种可持续且高效的生产天然类胡萝卜素的方式，其优势包括易于培养、生长迅速、光合作用高效、产量高、不占用耕地，以及利用CO(2)和废水。随着对天然类胡萝卜素需求的增长，探索提高微藻中类胡萝卜素产量的方法至关重要。这需要全面理解微藻类胡萝卜素代谢背后的调控机制。本综述涵盖了真核微藻中类胡萝卜素生物合成调控架构的最新进展，重点阐述了化学和环境信号如何重编程转录、翻译后修饰、染色质状态、表观遗传标记和代谢通量，以平衡类胡萝卜素积累与细胞生长及胁迫耐受性。通过整合多组学、分子生物学和人工智能（AI）工具来解析这些多层面的调控机制，将能够理性工程化高质量智能微藻菌株，使其具有提高的类胡萝卜素产量、稳健的光合性能和改善的胁迫耐受性。本综述为工业应用中微藻类胡萝卜素生产的优化以及微藻类胡萝卜素代谢的调控机制提供了新见解。
